name: double-calendar
description: A date-picker calendar variant displaying two consecutive months.

lifecycle.deprecatedComment: Use calendar with its months slot (option visibleMonths) instead. Archive-only: the two legacy records stay frozen and keep their legacy keys, so they are not marked deprecated (legacy output must not change).

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the legacy holder. Its minimum width and minimum height records are pinned to this file by their legacy keys; the calendar parts live on calendar.

anatomyReview.notes: A9 (2026-11-21), owner decision C2: a frozen legacy holder (two months), deprecated by owner decision A729 a in favour of calendar's months slot. calendar is the only anatomy (option visibleMonths). The two legacy records keep their keys and move from part popover to container; no Figma, RSP or SWC source draws this component on its own. Same precedent as color-control.
